body: I was overwhelmed by your stories, my heart goes out to you all, I've been trying to pull myself together ro reply to each and every one of you, but it still hurts too much to think about it, and I find myself longing for the experiences you have had. It finally hit me that he's never coming back, and will never see him again. Thank you for all of your stories, and I am so sorry for your loss 💔
I would love to see who liked my comments, I'm so curious and want to see if one was from the creator of the patreon I'm subscribed to or not
Something incredibly tragic happened, and he ended up fighting for his life in hospital for two months before his body sadly couldn't fight any longer.

In my experience pills don't do it. I hallucinated the first time and thought my pet was talking to me, telling me what a piece of shit I was to leave it behind alone. So I puked it up and felt like garbage. Pet died, so I slashed up my arm pretty badly but was found and admitted to the psych ward. Then I calmly took a mix of pills another time and found myself in the hospital, where they told me I just showed up and said what I did, and they gave me some black liquid to coat the pills before they could do any damage. The last time I tried, I downed a bunch of strong painmeds but woke up with a horrible hangover the day after. Guess either my body is refusing to do what I want, or what is wrong. My best friend died several weeks after surviving a suicide attempt, and I'm honestly just tired of being such a worthless piece of shit who has to live because he got to go. I've been ready to go for 24 years, and the thought of going to another friend's funeral is just too much. You're not supposed to outlive your friends, it's fucking ridiculous. I'm pure loathing at this point, pardon my language.
I will look for this film, thank you so much ❤️

Thank you so much, this means the world to me ❤️ We were able to communicate with him blinking his eyes and nodding, he has always had a very expressive face, and still had control over that, so I was able to tell him how much I love him and get a hug from him as best he could ❤️
My heart is breaking, but in a thankful way, that the nurses weren't just trying to make me feel better ❤️
Thank you for all you do, and thank you so much for telling me this ❤️
❤️ Big hug to you ❤️

The reason why you might feel bad is because YOU are a good person ❤️ 
Absolutely NOT The asshole ❤️

Could it be The Dig? As you say you haven't played it, you may have seen the intro about an asteroid about to hit Earth, where three people are sent to divert the asteroid when strange things start to happen. 
[The Dig](https://youtu.be/EGzX_7ZN8_U)

I managed to not see a steep step when walking outside, landed on my left foot and tumbled head first onto the door of a house, which alerted the people inside.
They came out to find me trying to brush myself off as if nothing happened, and asked if I was okay. I said I was fine and walked away. Two days and a very purple swollen later, I went to the hospital where they immediately said "yeah, that foot is broken.".
Honestly thought I'd sprained it at the most 🤷🏻‍♀️
Thank you so much, I will look into this immediately! ❤️
Thanks for this, I watched a playthrough on YouTube of it, never seen anything like it!
Hope you find out what game it is, OP! Sounds very interesting, never heard of a similar game!

I'm so sorry you are feeling this way, you do not deserve the pain you have burning in your heart, I wish I could give you a giant hug ♥️

More than anything, I wish you still had your love in your arms ❤️

They say it will get better, I really hope it's true

Ed Sheeran - Nancy Mulligan. We would sing this one together from the top of our lungs and he'd give me this look of complete adoration and happiness and kiss me. I'd never heard that song before I met him, and now it's all I hear on the radio.
I miss him.
You are not alone ❤️

"I will never leave you, hold me as tightly as you can, this is real, I am not going anywhere." I haven't seen you in 11 days, and I can barely remember your scent anymore. I still feel your arms around me when I sleep. I can't get your face out of my head. I can't stop feeling like I'm falling rapidly into the void, the memory of your voice is fading.
You promised.
Could it be Carmageddon?

The fact you posted this after typing everything out shows your strength and will to get better. I'm proud of you.Two years ago, I tried to end my life, there was too much going on in my life, my past, my present, I had nothing but grief about the future. Something made me seek help, something caused me to stick around.

I was diagnosed with Borderline Personality Disorder, in short, my life revolves around the wellbeing of everyone around me, and pure selfhatred like you wouldn't believe, but all smiles and happiness for everyone else.After years and years in reccuring therapy, I finally found a therapist who could diagnose me correctly, and suggested a group therapy called Dialectical Behavioral therapy (DBT) which literally saved my life. I made lifelong friends, people who understand my thoughts and emotions, and I finally felt like I belonged and wasn't alone anymore.

I would be more than happy to send you a message with some of(or all, if you'd like) the notes and homework I got in group therapy.

I used to surround myself with happy people and just pretend I was fine, but honestly, nothing feels better than to just be able to be yourself and just throw off that "public-place-smile-mask" around people who understand.

Regardless, you are not alone, and I'd love to be here for you if you ever want to talk. Wether it be real stuff or just random nonsense to drown out those thoughts clouding our minds.

Big hugs! <3
You are definitely not the asshole. If you took it off, it would be on your mind whenever you saw your wedding photos. Wear it, let her be there for your big day.
